theme: Light theme preferred for clear, professional property management SaaS aesthetic. Ensures high trust, readability, and a non-clinical feel.

component_strategies.data_table: Use Shadcn Table. Features: sticky header, left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Badges for Status/Priority. Inline row hover actions. Use neutral borders (`border-slate-200`). Ensure dense view for data scannability.
component_strategies.chat_interface: Resident view. Bottom sticky input area (textarea + submit). Bubbles for history. Resident messages on the right (slate-900), System/Staff messages on the left (slate-100). Clean borders. Max-width constraints to maintain readability.
component_strategies.sidebar: Staff view. Narrow vertical sidebar (`w-64`) with clear icon+text links. `bg-white` with right border `border-slate-200`.
component_strategies.badges: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) with soft background colors and darker text for readability (e.g. status/lanes).
component_strategies.detail_panel: Use a sliding Side Panel (Shadcn Sheet) for issue details to keep context of the table. Include a vertical timeline for interaction history.
component_strategies.login_screen: Split screen layout: Left side clean login form (Google SSO button prominent), Right side high-quality property image.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. Sidebar + Main Content area. Table takes full width of main area (`flex-1`). Strict alignment, 100% pixel utilization.
grids_and_layouts.resident_form: Mobile-first centered layout. Max width `max-w-2xl` for chat interface. Generous padding (`p-6` or `p-8`), floating above the background.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle background shifts (e.g., `hover:bg-slate-100` on rows) and icon color changes. Must explicitly set text color on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions: `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform duration-200 ease-out`. Never use `transition-all`.
motion_and_interactions.chat_entry: Staggered fade-up animation for new chat bubbles.
motion_and_interactions.sheet_slide: Smooth transform for the detail view sliding from the right.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.forms: All inputs must have associated labels. Chat input must handle Enter/Shift+Enter properly.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings: `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2`.

login_background.description: A modern apartment building with glass balconies reflecting a soft pink sky (used for the staff login right-side panel).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing on a clean, professional property management SaaS feel using the specified Slate/Indigo neutral theme.

For the Resident side, build a chat-style interface. Do not require login. Prompt for name, unit, message, and optional category in a conversational flow or a simple form that mimics chat bubbles. Allow them to see submitted requests status.
For the Staff side, build a data-heavy dashboard with Shadcn table. Include columns: Unit, Resident, Category, Priority, Lane, Status, Assigned team, Created time.
Use a Slide-over (Sheet) for the Staff Issue Detail View, featuring a timeline of interactions and status/lane/team update dropdowns.
Adhere strictly to the color palette (slate variants). Teal is completely forbidden for this dashboard.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and links have a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
Implement Google Login screen for the staff side (UI only).
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts except for the resident chat container which should be max-width centered.
Do not use generic transitions like 'transition: all'. Explicitly define properties.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns. Use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
Create depth using the defined subtle shadows and borders, avoiding flat 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Provide empty states for data tables using illustrations or clear typography.
Ensure generous padding (`p-6` to `p-12`) inside major container blocks.
